result.description: Cloud-based messaging app with a free HTTP Bot API (BotFather tokens) and an MTProto user-account API for sending messages, managing chats, and building bots.
result.auth_detail: Bot API: per-bot token from @BotFather, embedded in the URL path (api.telegram.org/bot<token>/METHOD). User-account (MTProto/TDLib) API: api_id + api_hash from my.telegram.org, plus phone-number login and session string. There is no OAuth2 authorization-code flow for third-party access to user accounts. Telegram Login URL authorization exists, but it is for website login, not API access.
result.access_detail: Anyone can message @BotFather to get a bot token at no cost. The api_id for user accounts is created at my.telegram.org. Both APIs are free. Broadcasting above 30 msgs/sec costs Stars (paid).
result.api_notes: The Bot API is HTTPS (GET/POST) with 100+ methods: messages, media, chats, inline mode, payments, webhooks and getUpdates. The separate MTProto/TDLib API gives full user-account access and is used through SDKs such as Telethon. Bots only see chats they have been added to or messaged in, and cannot start conversations with users.

evidence.quote: The Bot API is an HTTP-based interface created for developers keen on building bots for Telegram.
To get started, message @BotFather on Telegram to register your bot and receive its authentication token.
You will get basic addresses as well as the api_id and api_hash parameters required for user authorization.
The Telegram Bot Platform hosts more than 10 million bots and is free for both users and developers.
You are welcome to use both APIs free of charge.

We support GET and POST HTTP methods.
It exposes Telegram account, chat, message, contact, media, folder, and admin operations through the Model Context Protocol
By default, bots are able to message their users at no cost
